definition.prompt: Create a photorealistic reference photo of a friendly adult Pembroke Welsh corgi with orange-and-white fur, a centered white facial blaze, upright ears, dark brown eyes and a plain forest-green bandana. Show the entire dog sitting, facing slightly toward the camera, with all paws and both ears fully visible. Soft daylight, warm light-gray studio background, realistic fur. No toys, text or logos. Square image.

review.notes: Inspected orange-and-white corgi sitting against warm gray: centered white blaze, upright ears entirely in frame, four paws visible including the rear paw between front legs, plain forest-green bandana, no text or props. Pet reference accepted.
